description.en: A highly efficient e-commerce engine built with PHP and MySQL. Developed as a centralized dashboard and rebranded for three separate major stores (Noda, Gedo, Rose).

problem.en: Managing multiple client e-commerce stores with entirely different codebases is a maintenance nightmare. A unified, scalable backend was needed to power various storefronts while maintaining unique branding.

solution.en: Developed a robust, centralized PHP/MySQL dashboard that acts as the core engine. By applying rebranding strategies, the exact same powerful infrastructure successfully runs Noda, Gedo, and Rose independently.

outcome.en: Achieved extreme scalability and reduced maintenance time by 80%. Any feature added to the core dashboard instantly benefits all connected e-commerce stores.

description.en: A state-of-the-art React e-commerce platform that shares its core with Kenz, but is uniquely supercharged with an internal Point of Sale (POS) system for physical store checkouts.

problem.en: Al Khair operates both online and offline. Using separate systems for web orders and physical store checkouts caused inventory mismatches and accounting headaches.

solution.en: Built a unified React dashboard combining the e-commerce backend with a fully functional Point of Sale (POS) screen. The POS seamlessly handles cash/card transactions for walk-in customers while syncing inventory globally.

outcome.en: A perfect omnichannel experience. Online sales and physical walk-in sales now deduct from the exact same inventory in real-time, eliminating out-of-stock errors and simplifying accounting.

description.en: A premium WordPress and WooCommerce store tailored for high-end retail, featuring local payment gateways and optimized performance.

problem.en: The client needed a quick-to-market, reliable, and premium e-commerce presence without the overhead of a custom-built infrastructure.

solution.en: Configured a high-end WooCommerce storefront with customized themes and secure integrations for local payment gateways like Mada, Tabby, and Tamara.

outcome.en: Launched a beautiful, conversion-optimized store that handles transactions securely, boosting client revenue effortlessly.

description.en: A fast, scalable services offering platform with a full admin dashboard hosted on edge networks, allowing dynamic management of identity, content, and services.

problem.en: The business needed a dynamic digital presence to list and offer their professional services, requiring a dashboard that non-technical staff could use to update site settings and content.

solution.en: Engineered a React-based platform (deployed via Pages) with a comprehensive Site Settings dashboard. It empowers administrators to customize everything from the Hero section to the overarching site identity in real-time.

outcome.en: A highly performant portal (https://arab-anglais.pages.dev/) that significantly improved their service discoverability while removing the need for a webmaster to do daily updates.

description.en: A massive B2B CRM application built with Next.js featuring automated WhatsApp workflows, deal pipelines, agenda management, and comprehensive company administration.

problem.en: Corporations lose track of sales pipelines and client communications when using scattered tools. They needed a centralized system to manage deals and automatically follow up with leads.

solution.en: Developed a full-stack Next.js CRM. Features include an interactive Agenda, drag-and-drop Deal pipelines, and a native WhatsApp automation module that sends triggered messages to clients based on deal stages.

outcome.en: Sales conversions increased as lead follow-ups were fully automated. The team gained a 360-degree view of all company operations and client interactions in one fluid interface.

description.en: A robust CRM simulation of Odoo 17 built on Python and Docker, packed with WhatsApp automation, agenda tracking, and extensive deal management.

problem.en: The client required an enterprise-grade ERP/CRM structure mimicking the capabilities of Odoo 17 but engineered natively in Python for custom security and deployment (Docker) requirements.

solution.en: Architected a highly scalable Python application containerized with Docker. It faithfully replicates Odoo's CRM features including pipelines and agendas, strictly integrating a WhatsApp automation engine.

outcome.en: Delivered a massive, enterprise-ready infrastructure. The Dockerized deployment ensures flawless scalability across any server environment while unifying internal operations.

description.en: A specialized management platform for illustrators and animators to organize tasks, track assets, and automatically compile previewable CSS files.

problem.en: Animation studios suffer from chaotic file sharing and disorganized tasks between illustrators and animators, lacking a unified preview mechanism for their work.

solution.en: Built a centralized management hub tailored for creative teams. It tracks task progression from illustration to animation and concludes by generating a combined CSS file for seamless final previews.

outcome.en: Studio workflows became streamlined and highly organized. The automated CSS extraction saved hours of manual compilation, bridging the gap between designers and developers.

description.en: A beautifully crafted, high-performance static frontend project showcasing a premium sushi restaurant's menu and ambiance.

problem.en: The restaurant needed an incredibly fast, visually striking web presence that immediately conveys luxury and Japanese aesthetics without complex backends.

solution.en: Focused purely on frontend excellence, delivering a highly optimized static site with fluid animations, exquisite typography, and flawless responsiveness.

outcome.en: A visually breathtaking online menu that hooks customers instantly and loads in milliseconds, proving that pure UI work can heavily impact branding.
